description: This Java class 'EmailTemplate' provides static methods to generate email templates for account creation, deletion, and password change notifications, using constants from 'EmailConstant'. It constructs a map with recipient and sender information for email content.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to generate email templates with recipient and sender details.

methods.name: getAccountCreatedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map representing the email template for account creation, including recipient name and message.

methods.name: getAccountDeletedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map representing the email template for account deletion, including recipient name and message.

methods.name: getChangePasswordEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map representing the email template for password change notification, including recipient name and message.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Private helper method that creates a base template map with recipient and sender information.
